title: How Eddie Bo's ballad became In the Same Old Way
summary: Ridgley changed Eddie Bo's slow ballad to an up tempo; the WYLD program director told him to take it to Larry McKinley. Only other easy radio break was Papa Stopper and When I Meet My Girl.
